name: 大话西游 (A Chinese Odyssey)
english_name: A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You)
english_description: The original archive was labeled "Wuhan Station," but that's just a collector's site tag — the game's own config and login banner identify its true name as A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You), themed after the beloved Stephen Chow film, and run by the Xiangfan branch of Hubei's Chutian Hotline network. It belongs to the ES II (Eastern Stories II) engine family, sharing lineage with this collection's wmkj and tiexuejianghu, though each was developed independently.
